§§§§ a workflow file with odd spacing
name:   build
on: [push,  pull_request]
env: {NODE_VERSION: 22,   CI: true}
jobs:
  test:
      runs-on: ubuntu-latest
      strategy:
          matrix:
              node: [ 20, 22 ]
              os: [ubuntu-latest,windows-latest]
      steps:
        - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        - name:    Install
          run:   npm ci && npm test
        - run: |
            echo "line one"
            echo "line two"
          if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' }}
§§§§ strings that must stay strings
a: "yes"
b: 'no'
c: "123"
d: '1.0'
e: "null"
f: "~"
g: "true"
h: '0x1F'
i: "2026-11-19"
j: "12:30"
k: ""
l: ''
m: " leading and trailing "
n: "a: b"
o: "x # not a comment"
p: '@handle'
q: "- not a list"
r: "[not, a, list]"
s: "{not: a map}"
t: '*not_an_alias'
u: "&not_an_anchor"
v: "!not_a_tag"
w: "%percent"
x: "`backtick`"
y: '|'
z: ">"
§§§§ quotes and escapes
a: "tab\there"
b: "new\nline"
c: "quote \" inside"
d: 'it''s'
e: "it's"
f: 'say "hi"'
g: "both ' and \""
h: "☺ \x41 \e[0m \0"
i: "back\\slash"
j: 'back\slash stays'
k: "trailing backslash \\"
l: "line one\
  continued"
m: "é ₹ 😀 नमस्ते"
n: 'single
  folded
  lines'
o: "double

  with a blank line"
§§§§ values as typed
int: 42
neg: -7
octal: 0o14
old_octal: 012
hex: 0x1F
float: 1.50
exp: 1e3
Exp: 1.5E+10
inf: .inf
ninf: -.INF
nan: .NaN
sep: 1_000
bools: [true, True, TRUE, false, yes, No, on, OFF, y, n]
nulls: [null, Null, NULL, ~, ]
date: 2026-11-19
stamp: 2026-11-19T10:30:00+05:30
time: 12:30:45
version: 1.10
zip: 01234
plus: +91
empty:
tilde: ~
§§§§ block scalars
literal: |
  line one
    indented more
  line three

folded: >
  these lines
  are folded

  into paragraphs
strip: |-
  no newline at the end
keep: |+
  keeps the blank lines after it


strip_folded: >-
  folded and
  stripped
indent: |2
    starts with two extra spaces
  second line
hash: |
  # not a comment
  key: not a key
  - not a list
last: after
§§§§ anchors, aliases, merge keys and tags
defaults: &defaults
  adapter: postgres
  host: localhost
development:
  <<: *defaults
  database: dev
test:
  <<: [*defaults]
  database: test
list: &ports [80, 443]
again: *ports
scalar: &name Asha
ref: *name
tagged: !!str 123
float: !!float 1
binary: !!binary |
  R0lGODlhDAAMAIQAAP//9/X17unp5WZmZgAAAOfn515eXvPz7Y6OjuDg4J+fn5
custom: !mytag {a: 1}
seq: !!seq
  - a
set: !!set {a, b}
local: !local/type value
§§§§ several documents and directives
%YAML 1.2
---
first: 1
...
---
second: 2
---
- third
--- !!map
fourth: 4
--- |
  a literal document
---
# only a comment in this one
---
last: true
§§§§ comments everywhere
# top of the file

# second block
key: value # trailing
# between keys
list: # after a key
  # before the first item
  - a # item
  # between items
  - b
  # after the last item
map:
  # first in the map
  x: 1

  # after a blank line
  y: 2 # y
flow: [a, b] # flow
text: "has # no comment"
url: http://example.com/#anchor
# bottom of the file
§§§§ sequences and their indentation
not_indented:
- a
- b
indented:
  - a
  - b
nested:
- - a
  - b
- - c
-
  - d
of_maps:
  - name: x
    value: 1
  -   name: y
      value: 2
  - name: z
    children:
      - deep:
          - deeper: [1, 2]
empty_item:
  -
  - ""
  - ~
mixed: [1, [2, [3, {a: b}]], "x"]
§§§§ keys
plain key: 1
"quoted key": 2
'single quoted': 3
? complex key
: complex value
? [a, b]
: seq key
? {x: 1}
: map key
? |
  block key
: block value
1: number key
true: bool key
null: null key
~: tilde key
"": empty key
key with: colon
"key: with colon": x
a.b.c: dotted
a/b: slash
-dash: start
k@y: at
ключ: other scripts
🔑: emoji
§§§§ flow collections
empty_seq: []
empty_map: {}
seq: [a, b,c,   d]
map: {a: 1,b: 2, c:   3}
nested: {list: [1, 2, {x: y}], map: {k: [v]}}
multi: [
  one,
  two,
  three
]
long: [alpha, bravo, charlie, delta, echo, foxtrot, golf, hotel, india, juliet, kilo, lima, mike, november, oscar]
long_map: {alpha: 1, bravo: 2, charlie: 3, delta: 4, echo: 5, foxtrot: 6, golf: 7, hotel: 8, india: 9, juliet: 10}
quoted: ["a, b", 'c: d', "e]"]
pairs: [a: 1, b: 2]
trailing: [a, b, ]
json: {"a": 1, "b": [true, null]}
§§§§ plain scalars over several lines and long lines
description: this plain scalar
  continues on the next line
  and one more
long: this is one very long line that goes on and on past any print width a formatter might want to enforce on it, and it must stay one line or fold only where a fold means the same
url: https://example.com/a/very/long/path/that/cannot/be/broken/anywhere/without/changing/the/value/of/this/key?and=a&query=string
command: docker run --rm -it -v "$(pwd)":/work -w /work -e FOO=bar -e BAZ=qux --network host image:tag sh -c "make all && make test"
§§§§ compose file and a manifest
services:
  web:
    image: "nginx:1.27"
    ports: ["80:80", "443:443"]
    environment:
      - KEY=value
      - OTHER=a b c
    depends_on: [db]
    healthcheck: {test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost"], interval: 30s}
  db:
    image: postgres:17
    volumes:
      - db-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
volumes: {db-data: {}}
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata: {name: web, labels: {app: web}}
spec:
  replicas: 3
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx
        args: ["--port", "8080"]
        resources: {limits: {cpu: 500m, memory: 128Mi}}
